## R Markdown Code:

## load libraries

```{r }
library(nimble)

```

## load data
```{r }
load("BadgerDataSUBMISSION.RData")
```

## define model in Nimble
```{r }
code <- nimbleCode({
  
  ## survival components for dead badgers
  for (i in 1:nind) {
    
    ## likelihood for interval-truncated siler
    censored[i] ~ dinterval(tD[i], cint[i, ])
    tD[i] ~ dgompzMakeNim(amult[i], bmult[i], c1mult[i])
    
    log(amult[i]) <- log(a) + betaSEX[1] * sex[i] * zSEX[1] + 
      betaINF[1] * infection[i] * zINF[1] +
      betaINBR[1] * inbr[i] * zINBR[1] +
      betaINFSEX[1] * infection[i] * sex[i] * zINFSEX[1] +
      betaINBRINF[1] * inbr[i] * infection[i] * zINBRINF[1] +
      betaINBRSEX[1] * inbr[i] * sex[i] * zINBRSEX[1] +
      betaINBRINFSEX[1] * inbr[i] * infection[i] * sex[i] * zINBRINFSEX[1] +
      gammaSG[SG[i]]
    
    log(bmult[i]) <- log(b) + betaSEX[2] * sex[i] * zSEX[2]  + 
      betaINF[2] * infection[i] * zINF[2]  + 
      betaINBR[2] * inbr[i] * zINBR[2] +
      betaINFSEX[2] * infection[i] * sex[i] * zINFSEX[2] +
      betaINBRINF[2] * inbr[i] * infection[i] * zINBRINF[2] +
      betaINBRSEX[2] * inbr[i] * sex[i] * zINBRSEX[2] +
      betaINBRINFSEX[2] * inbr[i] * infection[i] * sex[i] * zINBRINFSEX[2]
    
    log(c1mult[i]) <- log(c1) + betaSEX[3] * sex[i] * zSEX[3]  + 
      betaINF[3] * infection[i] * zINF[3]  + 
      betaINBR[3] * inbr[i] * zINBR[3] +
      betaINFSEX[3] * infection[i] * sex[i] * zINFSEX[3] +
      betaINBRINF[3] * inbr[i] * infection[i] * zINBRINF[3] +
      betaINBRSEX[3] * inbr[i] * sex[i] * zINBRSEX[3] +
      betaINBRINFSEX[3] * inbr[i] * infection[i] * sex[i] * zINBRINFSEX[3] +
      gammaSG[SG[i]]
    
    ## sampling component
    pd[i] <- exp(y[i] * log(mean.p) + (min(floor(tD[i]), tM[i]) - y[i]) * log(1 - mean.p))
    dind[i] ~ dbern(pd[i])
  }
  
  ## priors
  for (k in 1:3) {
    betaSEX[k] ~ dnorm(0, sd = 1)
    betaINF[k] ~ dnorm(0, sd = 1)
    betaINBR[k] ~ dnorm(0, sd = 1)
    betaINFSEX[k] ~ dnorm(0, sd = 1)
    betaINBRINF[k] ~ dnorm(0, sd = 1)
    betaINBRSEX[k] ~ dnorm(0, sd = 1)
    betaINBRINFSEX[k] ~ dnorm(0, sd = 1)
    zSEX[k] ~ dbern(0.5)
    zINF[k] ~ dbern(0.5)
    zINBR[k] ~ dbern(0.5)
    zINFSEX[k] ~ dbern(0.5)
    zINBRINF[k] ~ dbern(0.5)
    zINBRSEX[k] ~ dbern(0.5)
    zINBRINFSEX[k] ~ dbern(0.5)
    
  }  
  
  for (r in 1:nSG){
    gammaSG[r] ~ dnorm(0, tau)
  }
  
  tau <- pow(sigma, -2)
  
  sigma ~ dunif(0, 10)
  a ~ dexp(1)
  b ~ dexp(1)
  c1 ~ dexp(1)
  mean.p ~ dunif(0, 1)
  
  ## constraints for interaction terms
  for (c in 1:3){
  constraint_dataINFSEX[c] ~ dconstraint(zINFSEX[c] <= zINF[c] * zSEX[c])
  constraint_dataINBRINF[c] ~ dconstraint(zINBRINF[c] <= zINBR[c] * zINF[c])
  constraint_dataINBRSEX[c] ~ dconstraint(zINBRSEX[c] <= zINBR[c] * zSEX[c])
  constraint_dataINBRINFSEX[c] ~ dconstraint(zINBRINFSEX[c] <= zINBR[c] * zINBRINF[c] * zINBRSEX[c])
  
  }
  
})

```

## set up constants and data
```{r }
consts <- list(nind = nind, tM = tM, sex = sex, infection = infection, inbr = as.numeric(CH$MLH), SG = as.numeric(CH$socg))

data <- list(
  y = y, cint = cint, censored = censored, tD = tD, dind = dind, constraint_dataINFSEX = rep(1, times = 3), 
  constraint_dataINBRINF = rep(1, times = 3), constraint_dataINBRSEX = rep(1, times = 3), constraint_dataINBRINFSEX = rep(1, times = 3))

```


## find and define overdispersed initial values
```{r }
tinitFn <- function(cint, censored) {
  apply(cbind(cint, censored), 1, function(x) {
    if(x[3] == 2) {
      y <- x[2] + rexp(1, 1)
    } else {
      y <- runif(1, x[1], x[2])
    }
    y
  })
}

initFn <- function(cint, censored) {
  ## get ML estimates as initial values
  optFn <- function(pars, t) {
    # browser()
    if(any(pars[1:2] < 0)) {
      return(NA)
    }
    ll <- sum(dGompzMake(t, a = pars[1], b = pars[2], c1 = pars[3], log = TRUE))  
  }
#  valid <- 0
#  while(valid == 0) {
    pars <- list(convergence = 1)
    k <- 0
    while(pars$convergence != 0 & k < 20) {
      ## sample missing values
      tD <- tinitFn(cint, censored)
      pars <- optim(rexp(3, 10), optFn, t = tD, control = list(fnscale = -1))
      k <- k + 1
    }
    if(k == 20) {
      stop("Can't sample initial values")
    }
    pars <- pars$par
    
    ## output initial values
    inits <- list(
      tD = tD,
      a = pars[1],
      b = pars[2],
      c1 = pars[3],
      mean.p = runif(1, 0, 1),
      betaSEX = rnorm(3, 0, 0.1),
      betaINF = rnorm(3, 0, 0.1),
      betaINBR  = rnorm(3, 0, 0.1),
      gammaSG = rnorm(40, 0, 0.1),
      sigma = runif(1, 0, 5),
      betaINFSEX = rnorm(3, 0, 1),
      betaINBRINF = rnorm(3, 0, 1),
      betaINBRSEX = rnorm(3, 0, 1),
      betaINBRINFSEX = rnorm(3, 0, 1),
      zSEX = rep(0, times = 3),
      zINF = rep(0, times = 3),
      zINBR = rep(0, times = 3),
      zINFSEX = rep(0, times = 3),
      zINBRINF = rep(0, times = 3),
      zINBRSEX = rep(0, times = 3),
      zINBRINFSEX = rep(0, times = 3)
    )
    
}
```


## build the model without initial values (will throw an initialisation warning)
```{r }
model <- nimbleModel(code, constants = consts, data = data, inits = initFn(cint, censored))
```

## compile the model
```{r }
cIndicatorModel <- compileNimble(model)
```

## configure MCMC - adjust custom samplers to improve mixing
```{r }
config <- configureMCMC(model)
config$removeSamplers(c("a", "b", "c1"))
config$addSampler(target = c("a", "b", "c1"), type = 'AF_slice')

```

## add reversible jump
```{r }
configureRJ(conf = config,   ## model configuration
                  targetNodes = c("betaSEX", "betaINF", "betaINBR", "betaINFSEX", "betaINBRINF", "betaINBRSEX", "betaINBRINFSEX"),
                  indicatorNodes = c("zSEX", "zINF", "zINBR", "zINFSEX", "zINBRINF", "zINBRSEX", "zINBRINFSEX"),
                  control = list(mean = 0, scale = 1))
```

## add monitors
```{r }
config$addMonitors("betaSEX", "betaINF", "betaINBR", "betaINFSEX", "betaINBRINF", "betaINBRSEX", "betaINBRINFSEX")
```

## build the MCMC
```{r }
rIndicatorMCMC <- buildMCMC(config)
```

## compile
```{r }
cIndicatorMCMC <- compileNimble(rIndicatorMCMC, project = model)
```

## run
```{r }
system.time(run <- runMCMC(cIndicatorMCMC, 
                           niter = 500000, 
                           nburnin = 24000, 
                           nchains = 2,
                           progressBar = TRUE, 
                           summary = TRUE, 
                           samplesAsCodaMCMC = TRUE, 
                           thin = 1))

```
